policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 05. Reclassify one bounded 12-Person philosophy/political-thought slice from legacy knowledge to culture. Every write requires live Production previous_domain=knowledge; any drift fails closed.

review_scope.selection_rule: Select twelve current Production knowledge Persons whose representative historical identity is clearly philosophy, political philosophy, intellectual history, or cultural criticism. Exclude economy-heavy and science/philosophy boundary cases for later focused review.

entries.basis: V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Zhu Xi is a preeminent Neo-Confucian philosopher and classicist whose enduring historical identity is his philosophical synthesis and intellectual influence.
V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Ockham is one of the major late-medieval philosophers, especially associated with logic, metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, and political philosophy.
V2 culture includes political thought and humanities. Machiavelli is represented by political theory, history, literature, and republican thought rather than by sustained exercise of sovereign power.

V2 culture includes philosophy and political thought. Hobbes's modern historical reputation rests chiefly on political philosophy, especially Leviathan, despite his work in mathematics and natural philosophy.

V2 culture includes philosophy and political thought. Locke is represented by empiricism, epistemology, natural-rights theory, and political philosophy; his medical and government work is secondary to that intellectual legacy.

V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Hume remains one of the most influential figures in the history of philosophy, with major work in epistemology, ethics, philosophy of religion, essays, and history.

V2 culture includes philosophy, political thought, and humanities. Rousseau's representative identity is his political philosophy, moral psychology, educational thought, and literary-intellectual influence.
V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Kant is a central figure of modern philosophy whose enduring impact spans metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, aesthetics, and political philosophy.
V2 culture includes philosophy and cultural criticism. Nietzsche is represented by philosophy and cultural critique of morality, religion, modernity, and values.
V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Heidegger is represented by twentieth-century philosophy, especially phenomenology, ontology, and existential thought.
V2 culture includes philosophy and political thought. Arendt is one of the major twentieth-century political philosophers and thinkers on totalitarianism, action, citizenship, and judgment.

V2 culture includes philosophy, intellectual history, and humanities. Foucault is represented as a philosopher and historian of systems of thought whose influence is especially strong across humanistic disciplines.
